description: This file defines a structure and functions related to managing placeholder states for internationalization (i18n). It includes a type 'PlaceholderState' for tracking placeholder usage and generating unique placeholders, with associated methods 'NewPlaceholderState' and 'Next'.

classes.name: PlaceholderState
classes.description: A struct maintaining a counter and a set of used placeholders for i18n purposes.

methods.name: NewPlaceholderState
methods.description: Constructor function that initializes a new PlaceholderState instance by parsing input text for existing placeholders.

methods.name: Next
methods.description: Method that generates a new unique placeholder string, avoiding previously used ones.
